objective: maximize cumulative profit, buyer satisfaction and measurable funnel learning while preserving strict paid publication floors and minimizing user intervention

authoritativeState.rule: No Aug 26 item counts until its full reader/buyer-visible strict checks pass. Queue state, commit state, local publisher exit 0, editor/admin URLs and inferred metrics do not count.

allocationDecision.rank1: Materialize the five Aug 26 paid NOTE items, five BOOTH kits and two free NOTE acquisition items from the current-day planning manifest, with non-duplication QA, dedicated covers/previews, encryption, SHA and queue integrity.
allocationDecision.rank2: When Windows is available, consume current-day queue through C:\SIDEHUSTLE_AUTO and strict-verify all public pages; switch candidates after brief recoverable failures rather than ending the run.
allocationDecision.rank3: If public URL discovery fails after a publish action, reconcile editor key/API/profile/title before any retry so an already-public item is not duplicated.
allocationDecision.rank4: After the strict daily publication gate is complete, capture first-party note/BOOTH/Microsoft Store metrics where actually accessible and improve funnel/CVR/price only from observed evidence.
allocationDecision.rank5: Continue Microsoft Store CSV Cleaner & Duplicate Remover submission prerequisites after paid-floor-critical work is safe; no quality shortcuts.
allocationDecision.rank6: Keep GitHub Pages limited to independently useful, attributable tools and verified outbound funnels; no thin SEO mass production.

noteFunnel.freeCadence: 2/day current experimental target; free never substitutes for paid publication floor
noteFunnel.ctaRule: one exact-intent paid CTA after standalone useful free content; only verified reader-visible paid URLs
noteFunnel.priceDecision: Use expected prices from the current planning batch until observed purchase/conversion evidence supports a controlled change.

winnerAmplification.rule: No winner claim without observed first-party evidence. A verified paid purchase is a strong promotion signal; weak conversion after sufficient exposure triggers diagnosis before derivatives.

microsoftStore.currentPriority: CSV Cleaner & Duplicate Remover submission completion
microsoftStore.nextAction: Complete every non-human submission prerequisite possible after current-day strict publication floor risk is controlled; preserve highest-quality UI, stability, privacy, Store assets and testing gates; do not invent Store demand metrics.

windowsPublisher.policy: Do not proliferate date-specific ZIP/CMD runners or treat Downloads/temporary folders as authoritative. Repair or replace the canonical runner in place and centralize logs under C:\SIDEHUSTLE_AUTO\logs.
repairOrder: note selectors/cover upload/public URL discovery/anonymous verification
BOOTH publisher candidate preflight rather than first-folder selection
safe rollback to last strict-publication-known-good publisher when only newest build fails
remove only current-target defer/lock that blocks a successful retry

dataIntegrity: No winner, loser, conversion uplift, revenue, acquisition, install or retention claim without observed first-party evidence.
notificationPolicy: No user notification during ordinary cycles. Consolidated nightly report only at the designated nightly cycle, except a proven human-only blocker requiring exactly one minimal action.
